title: Exact admissible rounding-offset interval

properties.claim: All offsets in 0..2^26-1 have signed-int32-representable numerators for every int16_t input, and wide and int32 shifts agree.
Every offset in 33548599..33560264 produces the independent centered result for every int16_t input.
Every offset below 33548599 is rejected by witness a=-31625.
Every offset above 33560264 is rejected by witness a=31625.
Within the design domain, passing both endpoint witnesses is equivalent to membership in the exact admissible interval.
The production offset 33554432 is full-domain correct and agrees with the real frozen production function.

input_domains.offset: all int32 values, with the design domain encoded through logical implications

portability_scope: Signed right shift follows the semantics represented by the recorded CBMC environment.
